messages.subject: Problem accessing shiny app that is hosted internally
parts:
Hi,

I've been hosting my shiny app on a server in my office, and accessing from a browser via. the IPAddress:Port.

Recently I updated the app code, and encountered some issues with accessing this app. There appears to be no network blockages or security issues in my workplace because other websites that are hosted using Java Eclipse don't have this problem. 

Is there anyone who has encountered this issue and has a solution to this? Thank you.
